briefdescription.para: This file defines a set of templates that efficiently compute a dominator tree over a generic graph.

detaileddescription.para: This is used typically in LLVM for fast dominance queries on the CFG, but is fully generic w.r.t. the underlying graph types.

Unlike ADT/* graph algorithms, generic dominator tree has more requirements on the graph's NodeRef. The NodeRef should be a pointer and, either NodeRef->getParent() must return the parent node that is also a pointer or DomTreeNodeTraits needs to be specialized.
